name: Misano World Circuit Marco Simoncelli
coordinates: x east, z south, y up; meters
bank_convention: Positive bank raises the geometric left road edge relative to center

metadata.layout: Grand Prix circuit (clockwise since 2007), 16 turns (10 right, 6 left), 530 m longest straight

start_finish.source: Start line at the front of the painted grid (full-width white line just ahead of the pole slot), identified in the Regione Emilia-Romagna RER 2023-24 orthophoto; about 10 m before OSM node 4503303472 (raceway=start-finish)

width.status: Measured from orthoimagery pavement colour; median 27 m and Gaussian 6 m smoothed; gaps interpolated

elevation.name: Regione Emilia-Romagna DTM 0,5x0,5m RER 2023-24 (LiDAR)
elevation.attribution: DTM 0,5x0,5m RER 2023-24 - Regione Emilia-Romagna, Archivio Cartografico (CC BY 4.0)
elevation.bank: DEM cross slope between the measured edges, median and Gaussian smoothed, clamped to 8 degrees

imagery.name: Regione Emilia-Romagna Ortofoto RER 2023-24 RGB (20 cm)
imagery.attribution: Ortofoto RER 2023-24 RGB - Regione Emilia-Romagna, Archivio Cartografico (CC BY 4.0)

metadata.license: Open Database License 1.0 (ODbL) for OSM derived geometry, separate from repository MIT source code
metadata.attribution: OpenStreetMap contributors; Ortofoto RER 2023-24 RGB - Regione Emilia-Romagna, Archivio Cartografico (CC BY 4.0); DTM 0,5x0,5m RER 2023-24 - Regione Emilia-Romagna, Archivio Cartografico (CC BY 4.0)
limitations: Centerline is OSM geometry recentred on imaged pavement, not a survey
Kerb positions come from imagery colour; kerb height reuses Thunderhill's provisional profile
Grip, run-off surfaces, walls and barriers are not modelled
